title: Ukrainian authorities arrest four suspects in international ransomware operation
summary: Reported by Bleeping Computer, Ukrainian authorities, in collaboration with the Federal Bureau of Investigation, arrested four suspected members of an international ransomware organization linked to more than $40.5 million in ransom payments.
why_it_matters: Ransomware operations combine disruption with extortion, making recovery speed and data-resilience core business risks.
recommendation: Verify offline backups, test restores, harden remote access, and review segmentation to limit lateral movement.
